components.BingoGame.drawACategoryAndSca: Draw a category and scan a music card as usual. Agree on an answer time and start the countdown when the music begins, then flip the card when time is up. A correct answer lets you mark one free square in that category. Complete a row, column or diagonal to get Bingo.
components.BingoGame.atBeginnerLevelGues: At beginner level, guessing the exact year in the ±2 and ±4 categories also lets you remove one opponent's mark. Every draw is independent, so a category may repeat.
components.BingoGame.singlesidedPrinting: Single-sided printing · 100% scale · light use of colour.

bingo.categories.beginner.2.hint: Name the release year. An answer within 4 years earns a point.
